title: Add cut/duplicate, tree navigation, and keyboard shortcuts to designer
body:
## 完善设计器的各项功能 (Improve Designer Features)

### ✅ **ALL TASKS COMPLETED + CODE REVIEW FIXES**

This PR successfully implements several high-priority enhancements to the Object UI Designer and addresses all code review feedback.

---

### 🔧 Code Review Fixes

#### 1. **Fixed Expansion Context Logic Bug** ✅
- Changed from simple boolean flags to discriminated union approach
- Prevents both `expandAll` and `collapseAll` from being true simultaneously
- Uses trigger comparison to determine active state

#### 2. **Added Deep Clone Utility** ✅
- Implemented `deepCloneNode` function with proper recursion
- Fixes shallow copy issues in `cutNode` and `duplicateNode`
- Prevents reference sharing between original and copied nodes

#### 3. **Fixed duplicateNode Clipboard Side Effect** ✅
- Removed unintended clipboard modification from `duplicateNode`
- Now only creates internal copy without affecting clipboard state
- More predictable behavior for users

#### 4. **Added JSDoc Documentation** ✅
- Comprehensive documentation for `findParentAndIndex` helper
- Documents purpose, parameters, and return value structure
- Improves code maintainability

#### 5. **Enhanced Test Coverage** ✅
- Added edge case tests for boundary conditions
- Tests moving nodes already at top/bottom positions
- Tests cutting non-existent nodes
- Better duplicate verification (checks type, content, position)
- Now 29 tests passing (3 new edge case tests)

#### 6. **Removed Unused Code** ✅
- Removed unused `screen` import from test file
- Removed unused `selectedNodeId` variable from ContextMenu
- Removed unused `cn` import from KeyboardShortcutsHelp
- Cleaner, more maintainable code

---

### 🎯 Originally Implemented Features

#### 1. **ComponentTree Expand/Collapse All** ✅
- Added `TreeExpansionContext` for global expansion state management
- Implemented `handleExpandAll` and `handleCollapseAll` functions
- Tree nodes dynamically respond to expansion/collapse events

#### 2. **Cut Functionality (Ctrl+X/Cmd+X)** ✅
- Added `cutNode` function with deep clone support
- Implemented as atomic copy + remove operation
- Integrated keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+X / Cmd+X)

#### 3. **Duplicate Functionality (Ctrl+D/Cmd+D)** ✅
- Added `duplicateNode` function with proper deep cloning
- Creates copy and inserts as immediate sibling
- No clipboard side effects

#### 4. **Move Up/Down Functionality** ✅
- Added helper function `findParentAndIndex` for tree navigation
- Implemented `moveNodeUp` and `moveNodeDown` functions
- Validates move operations before execution

#### 5. **Keyboard Navigation** ✅
- Ctrl+↑ / Cmd+↑: Move component up in parent container
- Ctrl+↓ / Cmd+↓: Move component down in parent container
- Proper edit mode checking

#### 6. **Keyboard Shortcuts Help Dialog** ✅
- Interactive modal showing all shortcuts
- Organized by categories (Editing/Clipboard/Organization)
- Visual keyboard key representations

---

### 📊 Test Results

```
Test Files  5 passed (5)
Tests      29 passed (29)  ← +3 new edge case tests
Duration   3.33s
```

**New Test Coverage:**
- ✅ Move node up when already at top (boundary condition)
- ✅ Move node down when already at bottom (boundary condition)
- ✅ Cut non-existent node (error handling)
- ✅ Enhanced duplicate verification (type, content, position)

---

### 📝 Files Changed

**Core Functionality:**
- `packages/designer/src/context/DesignerContext.tsx`
  - Added `deepCloneNode` utility function
  - Added JSDoc for `findParentAndIndex`
  - Fixed shallow copy issues in cut/duplicate
  - Removed clipboard side effect from duplicate
  
- `packages/designer/src/components/ComponentTree.tsx`
  - Fixed expansion context logic (discriminated union)

**Code Quality:**
- `packages/designer/src/__tests__/keyboard-shortcuts.test.tsx`
  - Removed unused `screen` import
  - Added 3 edge case tests
  - Enhanced duplicate test assertions
  
- `packages/designer/src/components/ContextMenu.tsx`
  - Removed unused `selectedNodeId` variable
  
- `packages/designer/src/components/KeyboardShortcutsHelp.tsx`
  - Removed unused `cn` import

---

### 🚀 Impact

**Code Quality:**
- ✅ No shallow copy bugs - proper deep cloning throughout
- ✅ Better expansion logic - no simultaneous expand/collapse
- ✅ Cleaner code - removed all unused imports/variables
- ✅ Better documentation - JSDoc for complex functions
- ✅ Enhanced testing - edge cases covered

**User Experience:**
- ⚡ More predictable duplicate behavior (no clipboard changes)
- 🎯 Robust move operations (handles boundaries gracefully)
- 📚 Well-documented codebase for future maintenance

All code review feedback addressed. Ready for merge.
